title: The exposed transfer

branches.consequence: If funded Shared passage is delivered and there is no funded Guard or valid Warrant, Lantern’s navigation team is lost. A lodged, available Grey Petrel on Tender cover prevents this loss and is spent.
A funded Guard or valid Warrant prevents this crew loss. Tender cover does not trigger and stays available.
This crew-loss effect does not occur. An unfunded or halted order still has its normal cost.

public_rules: Shared needs both Wayfarer and Lantern on Council. Passage still needs prepared Beacon 2+. Guard needs offered Vigil; a Warrant also needs imperial authority and opening Readiness 3+. Protection does not repair Beacon or avoid crossing wear.
use: Compare Shared with and without available protection. Buying this card does not predict whether either faction will supply it.
